segments.name: U.S. Stores
segments.description: Operates franchised and Company-owned Domino's stores in the U.S., earning royalties from franchisees and sales from Company-owned restaurants.
segments.evidence: Our U.S. stores segment is comprised primarily of our franchise operations, which consisted of 6,924 franchised stores located in the U.S. as of December 28, 2025.

segments.name: Supply Chain
segments.description: Distributes food and other products from supply chain centers to franchisees and Company-owned stores in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The supply chain segment primarily includes the distribution of food, and to a lesser extent, other products, from the Company's supply chain center operations in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: International Franchise
segments.description: Franchises Domino's stores in international markets through master franchisees, earning royalties and technology fees from their retail sales.
segments.evidence: During 2025, our international franchise segment accounted for $338.7 million, or 6.9%, of our consolidated revenues.

revenueModel.text: Franchisees pay royalties and fees and buy food and other products through the Company's supply chain, while store customers pay for food.
revenueModel.evidence: Domino's generates revenues and earnings by charging royalties and fees to our franchisees.
